gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: Tests to verify that it is possibly to merge {@link JsonIgnoreProperties.Value} instances for overrides
UPDATED o2 -> i4: ok to try to create from null; gives empty
UPDATED o3 -> i7: empty has "merge" set to 'true' so:
UPDATED o4 -> i11: Let's also verify JDK serializability
UPDATED o5 -> i18: when merging, should just have union of things
UPDATED o6 -> i19: when NOT merging, simply replacing values
UPDATED o7 -> i20: and effectively really just uses overrides as is
DELETED o8: no real good way to test but...
ADDED i2: Sample type carrying a fully-specified annotation, used to test {@code Value.from(...)}.
ADDED i3: Shared default instance: nothing ignored, no special flags, but merging enabled.
ADDED i5: The empty value ignores nothing and allows neither getters nor setters
ADDED i6: A value always equals itself
ADDED i8: Flipping merge off produces a value that no longer equals EMPTY (in either direction)
ADDED i9: Annotation-derived values never enable merging or allow getters/setters
ADDED i10: The "foo"/"bar" listed on the annotation become the ignored set
ADDED i12: Factories that describe "no configuration" all collapse to the shared empty instance
ADDED i13: Listing properties to ignore records them as the ignored set
ADDED i14: allowGetters=true: getters are no longer ignored, so nothing is ignored for serialization
ADDED i15: allowSetters=true: setters are no longer ignored, so nothing is ignored for deserialization
ADDED i16: withIgnored(...) replaces the ignored set; null clears it
ADDED i17: Each withXxx()/withoutXxx() pair toggles exactly its own flag
ADDED i21: Overriding with null or EMPTY changes nothing: same instance is returned
ADDED i22: mergeAll unions the ignored sets across all three values
ADDED i23: Different ignored sets must yield unequal values and (here) unequal hash codes
ADDED i24: hashCode of EMPTY: no precise expectation, but it should not be 0
ADDED i25: Builds an insertion-ordered set, mirroring how the production code stores ignored names.
